Definition: to run; also to delight in
BiblicalUsage: Ratsa' is to run — and also, by a second sense, to delight in. Ezekiel says of the living creatures, 'And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning.'
TheologicalSignificance: The lesson I take is that the running is the angels' swiftness: they run and return like lightning, and they never tire — because they run on God's errands.
